_note: Places marked N/A for surfing after the 11 Oct 2026 review. Never sent to Gemini (--skip-clear-na). The three marginal places (Falklands, Chiapas, Napa) were released on 11 Oct 2026 and will be sent.

ids.acadia: Rocky, cold Maine coast with no established surf break; the nearest surf schools are hours south.
ids.amalfi: Sheltered Tyrrhenian coast of steep cliffs and small pebble beaches, with no real swell.
ids.angkor: Inland temples; the Gulf of Thailand coast is hours away and its water is calm.
ids.antarctica: Ice-choked water with no surf infrastructure; trips are expedition cruises, not surf trips.
ids.arches-canyonlands: Desert, hundreds of miles from any coast, with no surfed river or lake wave.
ids.argentine-lake-district: Inland lakes and the Andes, with no ocean coast within a day trip.
ids.aspen: Mountain town far from any ocean; nothing surfable is a reason to visit.
ids.atacama: High desert; the Pacific coast and its breaks are hours away.
ids.badlands-black-hills: Landlocked prairie and hills, far from any ocean.
ids.bagan: Inland temple plain on the Irrawaddy, far from the coast.
ids.bangkok: Sits at the head of the Gulf of Thailand, where the water is calm and shallow with no ridable waves.
ids.banff: Mountain parks, far from any ocean.
ids.beijing: Inland, far from the Bohai Sea coast, which has no real surf.
ids.bend-crater-lake: High desert and a crater lake; the Oregon coast is about three hours away, so surf is not part of a trip here.
ids.berlin: Landlocked city; the Baltic coast is hours away.
ids.bhutan: Landlocked Himalayan kingdom with no coast.
ids.black-forest: Landlocked forest and hills, with no surf within a day trip.
ids.botswana: Landlocked inland delta with no ocean coast.
ids.budapest: Landlocked; the nearest coast is hundreds of miles away.
ids.buenosaires: Sits on the wide, muddy Río de la Plata, which has no ridable waves; Atlantic surf is hours away.
ids.chamonix: Alpine valley, far from any ocean.
ids.champagne: Landlocked wine region in northern France; the coast is hours away.
ids.chiang-mai: Landlocked northern Thailand, far from the sea.
ids.chilean-lake-district: Lakes and volcanoes inland; the Pacific coast is a long drive away and has no developed surf scene tied to this region.
ids.churchill: Arctic Hudson Bay, icy for much of the year, with no ridable waves.
ids.colombian-andes: Mountain coffee region; the Pacific coast is a long way off.
ids.cotswolds: Landlocked English countryside, hours from the nearest surf coast.
ids.death-valley: Desert far below sea level, far from any ocean.
ids.denali-interior: Interior Alaska, hundreds of miles from the coast.
ids.dolomites: Alpine mountains, far from any ocean.
ids.ecuadorian-andes: High Andes; the Pacific surf towns are many hours away.
ids.el-chalten: Patagonian mountains and glacier lakes, far from the ocean.
ids.everglades: Calm, shallow bay and Gulf water along a mangrove shoreline; no ridable waves in the park.
ids.glacier-waterton: Mountain parks and lakes, far from any ocean.
ids.grandcanyon: Desert canyon; the river rapids are for rafting, and the ocean is far away.
ids.great-smoky-mountains: Landlocked mountains, hours from the Atlantic.
ids.greenland: Arctic fjords with ice-choked water and no surf infrastructure.
ids.guilin-yangshuo: Inland river and karst landscape, far from the coast.
ids.hudson-valley: Inland river valley with no ridable waves; the nearest ocean surf is about two hours away at Rockaway Beach (counted under New York City).
ids.jordan: Desert; the only coast is the calm Gulf of Aqaba, which has no swell.
ids.joshua-tree: Desert about two hours from the nearest ocean surf; the draw is hiking and climbing.
ids.kaziranga: Inland river plain in northeast India, far from the sea.
ids.kenya: Inland safari parks; the Indian Ocean coast is a long way off.
ids.kruger: Inland bushveld, far from the coast.
ids.lake-district: Landlocked lakes and fells; the nearby Irish Sea coast has small waves and surf is not a reason to visit.
ids.lapland: Inland Arctic forest and lakes; the nearest sea is the Gulf of Bothnia, which freezes and has no ridable waves.
ids.london: Inland on the Thames; the closest surf is small, inconsistent North Sea windswell on the Kent coast, about two hours away.
ids.luangprabang: Landlocked mountain valley on the Mekong.
ids.mendoza: Desert at the foot of the Andes; the Pacific is across the mountains.
ids.mexicocity: High-altitude inland city; the nearest Pacific surf towns are many hours away.
ids.milford-sound-fiordland: Sheltered fjords with steep walls and no beaches or ridable waves; the open west coast is remote and not set up for surfing.
ids.new-orleans: Muddy river, lakes and marsh; Gulf waves are small and far from the city.
ids.north-cascades: Mountain park in Washington; the Pacific surf coast is hours away.
ids.pakistan: Mountains, plains and desert; surf is not a reason to visit.
ids.pantanal: Inland wetland, far from the ocean.
ids.paris: Inland, hours from the nearest Atlantic or Channel surf.
ids.peru: High Andes; the Pacific surf coast is a long way off.
ids.peruvian-amazon: Rainforest river basin; the Pacific coast is across the Andes.
ids.piedmont: Landlocked wine and mountain region, hours from the sea.
ids.prague: Landlocked city in the Czech Republic.
ids.queenstown: Inland lakes and mountains; the nearest surf coast is hours away.
ids.rajasthan-golden-triangle: Desert and plains, far from the coast.
ids.rioja: Landlocked wine region; the Basque coast, covered under Basque Country, is about two hours away.
ids.san-miguel-guanajuato: High inland colonial towns, hours from the sea.
ids.sedona: Desert canyon country, far from any ocean.
ids.sequoia-kings-canyon: Sierra mountain parks; the California coast is hours away.
ids.singapore: Sheltered strait and port waters; no swell reaches the island.
ids.svalbard: Arctic sea ice and glacier fjords with no surf infrastructure.
ids.swissalps: Alpine resort area with no coast; the city river waves in Bern and Zurich are outside this place.
ids.tanzania: Inland safari parks; the coast and Zanzibar are separate from this place.
ids.tbilisi-caucasus: Inland mountains and a wine city; the Black Sea coast is far away and not a surf destination.
ids.texas-hill-country: Inland hills; the Gulf coast is hours away and its waves are small.
ids.tierra-del-fuego: The Beagle Channel and Ushuaia are sheltered and cold; the exposed Atlantic side has a thin surf scene (one surfer near Río Grande) and harsh, inconsistent conditions.
ids.torres-del-paine: Remote Patagonian mountains and lakes, far from the exposed Pacific coast.
ids.uluru: Desert interior, far from any coast.
ids.uyuni: Salt flat high in the Andes, landlocked.
ids.venice: Calm, shallow Adriatic lagoon with no swell; the open sea beyond the barrier islands rarely has ridable waves.
ids.vienna: Landlocked city on the Danube, far from the sea.
ids.whistler: Sheltered Strait of Georgia and mountains; the open surf coast of Vancouver Island is a ferry and a long drive away, covered under Vancouver Island.
ids.yosemite: Mountain park; the California coast is hours away.
ids.zambia: Landlocked; the rivers and falls are for rafting.
ids.zimbabwe: Landlocked; the Zambezi is for rafting, not surfing.
ids.zion-bryce: Desert canyons, far from any ocean.
